website.hint: e.g. websites of professional societies, tables of contents, conference proceedings

citation_search.hint: Forward or backward searching starting from seed documents

contact.label: Contact with experts or organisations
contact.hint: e.g. requests to authors, professional societies or manufacturers

meta.heading: Project-wide search information
meta.filtersHint: (Validated) search filters used, with their source (PRISMA-S item 10)
meta.priorWorkHint: Were search strategies from other reviews reused or adapted? (PRISMA-S item 11)
meta.updatesHint: When and how was the search updated? (PRISMA-S item 12)
meta.peerReview: Peer review of the search strategy
meta.peerReviewHint: e.g. PRESS checklist – by whom? (PRISMA-S item 14)

sourceForm.name: Name

nameHint.database: Name of the database or of the combined search, e.g. “MEDLINE” or “EBSCOhost”
nameHint.citation_search: e.g. backward searching in included studies
nameHint.contact: e.g. a professional society or research group

sourceForm.platformHint: e.g. Ovid, EBSCOhost, PubMed, Web of Science; for Scopus the same as the name (PRISMA-S item 1)
sourceForm.databasesHint: Only if one search covered several databases on one platform simultaneously. A combined search is one source (PRISMA-S item 2).

runForm.dateToHint: Optional, if the search extended over several days.
runForm.searchStringHint: Complete and exactly as executed, including line numbers (PRISMA-S item 8).
runForm.copied: Search string copied to the clipboard.
runForm.copyFailed: Copying is not possible in this browser.
runForm.limitsHint: e.g. publication years, languages, document types; leave empty if none were set (PRISMA-S item 9)
runForm.reportedHitsHint: Number as reported by the source; compared with the number of imported records.

toolHint.search_engine: How were the results exported? e.g. Publish or Perish, GSscraper
toolHint.citation_search: e.g. manual, Citationchaser, Scopus, Web of Science

runForm.seedDocumentsHint: e.g. the included studies or specific key publications
runForm.descriptionHint: What was done and how; who was contacted with which request? (PRISMA-S items 6 and 7)
runForm.deleteBody: The search run of {{date}} will be deleted.
